scope.profile: Decoded straight ACIS edge; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted edge also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_projectPointToAcisStraightEdge projects onto the closed parameter interval derived from both topological endpoint coordinates.
scope.parameter_policy: Preserves the raw p0 + t*p1 curve parameterization; endpoint order does not change the closed interval.
scope.endpoint_policy: Both endpoints must be present, finite, and within an explicit caller-supplied tolerance of the decoded straight curve.
scope.tolerance_policy: Endpoint curve tolerance must be finite and nonnegative; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred.
scope.refusal_policy: Missing/off-curve endpoints, invalid tolerance, unsupported curve, invalid query, or unrepresentable intermediate/result returns false without changing outputs.
non_claims: B-rep validity or native/independent semantic qualification
